icons.name: chevron-down
icons.description: Opens what is below or after: a list, a panel, a menu. Also a column sorted in descending order.

icons.name: chevron-left
icons.description: Goes back: the previous page, month or tab. In a right-to-left page, it points forward.

icons.name: chevron-right
icons.description: Goes forward: the next page, month or tab, or the next level of a breadcrumb. In a right-to-left page, it points back.

icons.name: chevron-up
icons.description: Closes what is open below: a panel, a group. Also a column sorted in ascending order.

icons.name: chevron-up-down
icons.description: A column a table can sort, not sorted yet.

icons.name: close
icons.description: Closes a dialog or a message, or removes an item, like a tag.

icons.name: danger
icons.description: An error, or a destructive action: the status of an alert, a message or a field.

icons.name: external-link
icons.description: A link that leaves the application, or opens in a new tab.

icons.name: information
icons.description: Information: the status of an alert, a message or a badge.

icons.name: success
icons.description: A success or a confirmation: the status of an alert or a message.

icons.name: warning
icons.description: A warning that asks for attention: the status of an alert or a message.
